steps.content: Outside the exhibition hall, a dozen incapacitated guards lie scattered across the floor.
Right nearby, a woman in a violet catsuit with gentle wavy hair leans against the window. She observes the situation in the hall, calm and composed.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: One section for each of us, as if to test us through missions... Just what are you hoping to learn about us...?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Chief of Minos.
Kisugi Rui shakes her head, trying in vain to shake off the dizziness caused by that eerie power.
Still, she pulls herself together and speaks into the communicator.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hitomi, go. Leave the rest to me.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Retrieve the painting and rendezvous with Ai on the rooftop.

After issuing the instructions to her sisters, Kisugi Rui's eyes snap to her tracker. The red dots are approaching. In one fluid motion, she ducks to the side of an unconscious guard and plucks the keyring from his belt.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Sorry, I'll have to borrow this for now.
The gallery's security supply room is just ahead. Using the guard's keys, Kisugi Rui unlocks the depot door and slips inside.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Let's hope this little drone finds its way home.
As she cuts through the glass case, no alarm sounds. Kisugi Hitomi knows it must be her little sister who disabled the firewall.
When she takes the painting and checks the tracker again, the red dots remain where they were before. Kisugi Hitomi knows her older sister has kept them all at bay.
Realizing this, Kisugi Hitomi breaks into a full sprint.
With the piece of Otherland Angels in hand, she flings open the door to the rooftop.
The night sky arches above, and there, framed by the evening wind, are her sisters, their hands reaching out to her.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Sorry to keep you waiting! I've got the second piece of Otherland Angels!
Kisugi Hitomi gazes at the piece of Otherland Angels in her hand. A beautiful painting by her father from her original world comes to mind.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Rui! Ai! Look! With this, the painting is almost complete. Just one more piece to go!
Kisugi Hitomi rushes to her sisters. The three sisters simply gaze at the recovered piece of the Otherland Angels, their joy too vast for words.
Yet, in that very swell of triumph, something black emerges... something viscous... In the pooling shadows at their feet, a familiar and chilling rift silently yawns open.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Rui! Ai! Look out!!!
The eerie rift bursts open! A wave of black contaminants surges out, engulfing Hitomi's feet almost instantly.
